_comment: THE OPENAPI HARNESS, created 2026-10-03 for bean `s4ta`. Owner: "really there should be a KG harness specfiic to openapi docuemnataiton sources with its own rendering sub-pipeline. and then the smart-trust repo has a smart-base harness and a openapi harness. openapi ahrness could be in cat-harness repo for now" -- and, on its shape: "kind is an OpenAPI node. need page + IRI for each operation. swagger style can be dynamically geenated. use dynamic loading as much as possible." Staged as a sibling directory like cat-harness-tools; after the split it moves with the harness layer and only `livesAt` changes.
name: cat-openapi
title: C@T OpenAPI
description: The OpenAPI harness: holds OpenAPI 3 documents as nodes of graph kind `openapi`, and gives every operation in them a page and an IRI, rendered in the browser from the served document.

directories.description: The harness's shapes: `cat-openapi.config.json` (what an instance names), the ingest's provenance node, the subset of OpenAPI 3 the pages read, and how an operation's id is derived.

The rendering sub-pipeline: `ingest-openapi.ts` copies a configured document in verbatim with its provenance; `gen-openapi-pages.ts` writes a JSON-LD node and a thin page per document and per operation; `templates/` holds the one shared loader that draws them in the browser.
